description: CSV Reader parses the bare 3D WKT (no Z tag) that the CSV Writer emits, then CSV Writer re-emits it unchanged -- the write/read seam that let 3D WKT round-trips break before with_z_tag. A deliberately-unparseable row also exercises the `rejected` port end to end, so disabling the bare-3D tolerance fails on a content mismatch (four rejected rows instead of one) rather than a missing-file error indistinguishable from an unrelated regression. The expectedFile order is deliberate: rejected.csv must be checked before output.csv, because the harness stops at the first failing file and a totally-rejected run also empties output.csv, which would reproduce that same ambiguous missing-file failure if the order were reversed.
